pose: A sleek, industrial steel buoy serving as a weather station, featuring spinning wind cups of an anemometer and a slender metal telemetry antenna. A school of prehistoric squid are darting through the water below, occasionally breaching next to the buoy's anchor cable.

environmental_details.ground: Deep cobalt blue ocean water with exceptional vertical clarity, revealing the structural lower counterweight of the buoy.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Bright sky with high-altitude cirrus clouds and strong, directional cinematic shadows cutting across the steel hull.
